rows: The combination of strong winds and large hail damaged the roof of the Hawley Volunteer Fire Department.
Extensive damage was reported around Lake fort Phantom Hill with numerous reports of baseball size hail causing broken windows.

This tornado was observed for several minutes just to the southwest of Hodges.

Several tree limbs were downed by the intense thunderstorm winds around Anson. The high winds ripped half the roof off of an Anson apartment complex, and the high winds snapped a utility pole and an electrical line. A truck was destroyed when part of the metal roof landed on it.
